title: More accessible than other luxury goods, beauty defies the crisis
summary: A Louis Vuitton lipstick, a Lancôme cream or a niche fragrance rather than an unaffordable handbag? As the luxury sector seeks to regain momentum, sales of prestige beauty products continue to grow, driven by consumers who favor these more accessible purchases over fashion, leather goods, and jewelry. Despite an uncertain geopolitical environment and persistent inflationary pressures, the prestige beauty market continued to grow in the first half of 2026, with sales up 7% in North America,...
